verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a programmatic SDK for TypeScript, Python and Go that runs browser automations from code. It can launch remote Browserbase cloud browsers, launch local ones, or attach over CDP, and it supports caching and deterministic replay for repeatable automation runs. That fits non-interactive, scripted execution. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a headless mode/flag, CI pipeline setup guidance or examples, independent hands-on reports of running it in CI.
